title: Local perfect characterization for actual finite-extension valuation rings
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l whose actual valuation ring lies in Type (u+1), and T a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme in universe u on which l is invertible. For the actual datum pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], an object K belongs to the three-clause bounded constructible complete category if and only if there is a finite locally closed stratification and on every stratum a pro-etale covering sieve on which the actual derived pullback of K is the completed constant realization of a bounded complex of finite-projective O_E-modules. The complexes, their two strict term bounds and their realization isomorphisms may depend on the covering member. The restriction uses the small pro-etale site of the covering scheme, canonically equivalent to its slice site, and the normalized actual completed coefficient map. This is Proposition 6.6.11 with the actual coefficient presentation.

source.place: Definition 6.5.1 and Proposition 6.6.11; actual valuation-ring and covering-scheme formulation.

proof.text: For membership implies local perfectness, take the bounded constructible residue complex, refine its finite cohomology stratifications, and choose local constant perfect residue models. The complete DVR and residue-perfect lifting give bounded finite-projective integral models. The canonical pro-etale slice equivalence and completed coefficient pullback comparison express these models on the covering schemes.

Conversely the displayed finite-projective models are complete because they are finite free retracts in a bounded interval. Their finite reductions are locally finite constant. Quasi-compactness gives a finite subcover of each of the finitely many strata, yielding one interval for all reductions. Normalized local effectivity supplies the uniform constructible tower and finite-level site comparison supplies compatible etale origins. Exact local restriction detects each condition.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.6.11; the two characterization steps in the parent proof, before scalar extension.

theorem integralPadicLocalPerfectCriterion
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [IsNoetherian T]
    (hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n) (hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) :
    PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E) K ↔
      ∃ s : FiniteLocallyClosedStratification T, ∀ k : Fin s.n,
        ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ (s.domain k).ProEt),
          V ∈ ProEt.topology (s.domain k) (⊤_ (s.domain k).ProEt) ∧
          ∀ (U : (s.domain k).ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ (s.domain k).ProEt), V f →
            ∃ (P : CochainComplex
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) ℤ)
              (a b : ℤ),
              P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
              (∀ q : ℤ, Module.Projective (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (P.X q) ∧
                Module.Finite (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (P.X q)) ∧
              Nonempty ((pbcActualDerivedPull (U.hom ≫ s.immersion k)
                (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)).obj K ≅
                (integralConstantDerived U.left (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)).obj
                  ((completedConstantQ _).obj P))
